note: Good to know this month (under the map). Official sources only; summaries are our own words. 'until' = last day to show (blank = ongoing). Types: free, health, recall.

items.title: Free night at the Vancouver Art Gallery, Fri Dec 4
items.summary: Free for everyone 4–8 pm on the first Friday of the month. Kids and youth 18 and under are free any day. Reserve a spot ahead; walk-ins depend on space.

items.title: Kids 12 and under ride transit free
items.summary: Free on buses with no pass needed. On SkyTrain, SeaBus and West Coast Express, kids ride free with a paying adult, up to four kids per adult.

items.title: Free flu shots for kids 6 months and up
items.summary: Book at getvaccinated.gov.bc.ca or call 1-833-838-2323. Kids getting a flu shot for the first time may need two doses, four weeks apart.

items.title: Baby Brezza SuperFast Sterilizer Dryer
items.summary: Model BRZ0083 can overheat and melt, a fire and burn risk. Stop using it and contact the company for a free replacement.

items.title: Costway 3-in-1 Convertible High Chair
items.summary: SKU BB4640 has no crotch restraint, so a child can slip, fall or get trapped. Stop using it and ask Costway for a refund.
